final.scope: forward, mean shifted-token loss and all adapter gradients; fixed parameters
final.component_scope: block times include native host/device transfers; input_snapshot times CPU buffer cloning

physical_memory.scope: macOS kernel whole-process physical footprint; includes setup and runtime

verifier_source:
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
first=json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-off.json').read_text())
final=json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-owner.json').read_text())
guard=json.loads(Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-owner-guard/execution.json').read_text())
assert final['status']=='complete' and len(final['samples'])==100 and final['warmup_steps']==10
assert guard['status']=='complete' and guard['returncode']==0
assert final['parameters_unchanged'] and final['ort']['cpu_fallback_disabled']
assert final['environment']['ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_NO_SHARED_INITIALIZERS']=='0'
for key in ('benchmark_source_sha256','input_sha256','adapter_sha256','source_identity','input_shape','prediction_targets_per_step','versions','torch_threads','ort','onnax_source'):
 assert first[key]==final[key],key
with open('/tmp/onnax-shared-owner-runtime/libonnxruntime_mlx_ep.dylib','rb') as stream:
 assert final['library_sha256']==hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
checks={}
with np.load('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-off.npz',allow_pickle=False) as a,np.load('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-owner.npz',allow_pickle=False) as b:
 assert set(a.files)==set(b.files) and len(a.files)==60
 for name in a.files:
  assert a[name].dtype==b[name].dtype and a[name].shape==b[name].shape
  assert np.isfinite(a[name]).all() and np.isfinite(b[name]).all()
  np.testing.assert_allclose(a[name],b[name],rtol=1e-4,atol=1e-6)
  checks[name]={'byte_identical':a[name].tobytes()==b[name].tobytes(),'max_abs':float(np.max(np.abs(a[name]-b[name]))),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b[name].tobytes()).hexdigest()}
a=np.array([r['loss'] for r in first['samples']],np.float32);b=np.array([r['loss'] for r in final['samples']],np.float32)
np.testing.assert_allclose(a,b,rtol=1e-4,atol=1e-6)
final['guard']={k:v for k,v in guard.items() if k!='observations'}
final['guard']['peak_physical_bytes']=max(r['peak_bytes'] for r in guard['observations'])
r={'version':1,'final':final,'baseline_report':'shared-initializers-timing-m1max.json','gradients':checks,'all60_gradients_byte_identical':all(r['byte_identical'] for r in checks.values()),'all100_losses_byte_identical':a.tobytes()==b.tobytes(),'verifier_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-owner-final-timing-qualified.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'summary':final['summary'],'construction_seconds':final['bundle_load_and_sessions_seconds'],'session_creation_seconds':final['session_creation_seconds'],'physical_peak_GiB':final['guard']['peak_physical_bytes']/2**30,'all60_gradients_byte_identical':r['all60_gradients_byte_identical']}))
